entities.summary: Fautino De Los Santos is a Dominican former professional baseball relief pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Oakland Athletics in 2011 and 2012. He also played for the Musashi Heat Bears in Japan's Baseball Challenge League.
